title: Janet flights from McCarran to Area 51
place_text: McCarran Airport, Las Vegas to Area 51, Nevada

tellings.quote: I'd drive out to EG&G special projects which was right in McCarran Airport at that time.

plain: In 1988 and 1989, Bob Lazar says, he got to work by catching a flight from the Las Vegas airport to Area 51, a secret Air Force test site in the Nevada desert. He tells Michels he would "drive out to EG&G special projects," an office of the defense contractor EG&G that was "right in McCarran Airport at that time," and board the unmarked flights known as Janet that carried workers to the base. Lazar, a man who says he was hired in those years to work on alien craft near Area 51, tells this as his own experience. If it is true, it puts him on the secret daily commute to the site.
